summary.en: Returns the position of fader number `n`, from 0 to 1: the same as `fader1` to `fader8`, for any `n`.
summary.zh: 回傳第 `n` 支推桿的位置，0 到 1：跟 `fader1` 到 `fader8` 一樣，但 `n` 可以是任何數字。

description.en: The function form of [`fader1`](#fader1), for when the fader's number is a variable.
description.zh: [`fader1`](#fader1) 的函式版本，推桿的編號是變數的時候用。

params.name: n
params.en: Which fader, counting from 1.
params.zh: 第幾支推桿，從 1 開始算。

returns.en: The fader's position, 0..1; 0 until it has moved.
returns.zh: 推桿的位置，0..1；還沒推過之前是 0。

caption.en: Four dots that rise with four faders.
caption.zh: 四個點，跟著四支推桿升高。

summary.en: The position of a controller fader (slider), from 0 to 1: `fader1` is the first fader, up to `fader8`.
summary.zh: 控制器上推桿（滑桿）的位置，從 0 到 1：`fader1` 是第一支推桿，一直到 `fader8`。

description.en: Works exactly like [`knob1`](#knob1), for the controller's faders, numbered in the order the controller's profile lists them (as printed on the device). A controller with only four faders, like the MiniLab 3, has `fader1` to `fader4`.
description.zh: 用法跟 [`knob1`](#knob1) 完全一樣，只是對應控制器上的推桿，編號依控制器設定檔列出的順序（也就是機器上印的順序）。只有四支推桿的控制器（像 MiniLab 3）就只有 `fader1` 到 `fader4`。

value.en: Changes when the fader moves; 0 until it has moved.
value.zh: 推桿移動的時候才會改變；還沒推過之前是 0。

needs.en: Nothing to call; reading a fader asks for Web MIDI, like a knob.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫任何東西；讀推桿就會像旋鈕一樣去要 Web MIDI。

caption.en: A bar that follows fader 1. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 一條跟著推桿 1 走的橫條。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it whenever a fader moves.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式；推桿一移動，oav-p5 就呼叫它。

description.en: The fader twin of [`knobMoved()`](#knobMoved): `function faderMoved(n, value) { … }`.
description.zh: [`knobMoved()`](#knobMoved) 的推桿版本：`function faderMoved(n, value) { … }`。

params.name: n
params.en: Which fader (1 is the first).
params.zh: 哪一支推桿（1 是第一支）。

params.name: value
params.en: Where it is now, 0..1.
params.zh: 現在的位置，0..1。

caption.en: A bar that follows fader 1, driven by the event instead of a read.
caption.zh: 一條跟著推桿 1 的橫條，用事件驅動，不是每個畫面去讀。

summary.en: Returns the position of knob number `n`, from 0 to 1: the same as `knob1` to `knob8`, for any `n`.
summary.zh: 回傳第 `n` 顆旋鈕的位置，0 到 1：跟 `knob1` 到 `knob8` 一樣，但 `n` 可以是任何數字。

description.en: Use it when the number of the knob is a variable: `for (let i = 1; i <= 16; i++) bar(i, knob(i));`. It also works in a sketch that has its own `knob1`, which oav-p5 then leaves alone.
description.zh: 旋鈕的編號是變數的時候用它：`for (let i = 1; i <= 16; i++) bar(i, knob(i));`。草圖自己已經有 `knob1` 的話也可以用，oav-p5 不會去動那個名稱。

params.name: n
params.en: Which knob, counting from 1 (as printed on the controller).
params.zh: 第幾顆旋鈕，從 1 開始算（照控制器上印的）。

returns.en: The knob's position, 0..1; 0 until it has been turned.
returns.zh: 旋鈕的位置，0..1；還沒轉過之前是 0。

caption.en: Eight bars, one per knob. Knobs you have not touched stay at the bottom.
caption.zh: 八根長條，一顆旋鈕一根。還沒碰過的旋鈕停在最低。

summary.en: The position of a controller knob, from 0 to 1: `knob1` is the first knob, `knob2` the second, up to `knob8`.
summary.zh: 控制器上旋鈕的位置，從 0 到 1：`knob1` 是第一顆旋鈕，`knob2` 是第二顆，一直到 `knob8`。

description.en: Read it in `draw()` the way you read `mouseX`: `background(knob1 * 255)`. Knobs are numbered the way they are printed on the controller, so knob 1 is knob 1 on any controller OAV has a [profile](/controllers/) for: the MiniLab 3's first knob is CC 74, the LPD8's is CC 70. The sketch never needs to know a CC number.
description.zh: 像讀 `mouseX` 一樣在 `draw()` 裡讀：`background(knob1 * 255)`。旋鈕的編號照控制器上印的順序，所以在 OAV 有[設定檔](/zh/controllers/)的任何控制器上，旋鈕 1 就是旋鈕 1：MiniLab 3 的第一顆是 CC 74，LPD8 的是 CC 70。草圖完全不用知道 CC 號碼。

description.en: On a controller OAV has no profile for, the first knob you turn becomes `knob1`, the next one `knob2`, and so on, in the order you turn them. Past eight, use [`knob(n)`](#knob).
description.zh: 遇到 OAV 沒有設定檔的控制器，你轉的第一顆旋鈕就變成 `knob1`，下一顆是 `knob2`，依你轉的順序往下排。超過八顆就用 [`knob(n)`](#knob)。

value.en: Changes when the knob moves, not once per frame; the sketch just reads the latest value. 0 until the knob has been turned.
value.zh: 旋鈕轉動的時候才會改變，不是每個畫面一次；草圖只要讀最新的值。旋鈕還沒轉過之前是 0。

needs.en: Nothing to call. Reading a knob tells oav-p5 the sketch plays from MIDI, so it asks the browser for Web MIDI (Chrome, Edge, Firefox; Safari and iPad have none: use 🎹 or a phone there).
needs.zh: 不用呼叫任何東西。讀旋鈕就等於告訴 oav-p5 這份草圖要用 MIDI 玩，它會向瀏覽器要 Web MIDI（Chrome、Edge、Firefox 有；Safari 和 iPad 沒有，那裡改用 🎹 或手機）。

notes.en: A sketch that already has its own `knob1` (a `let`, a function) keeps it, and a card beside the 🎹 says what to read instead (`knob(1)`).
notes.zh: 草圖如果本來就有自己的 `knob1`（`let`、函式都算），就由草圖保留，🎹 旁邊會有一張卡片說明改讀什麼（`knob(1)`）。

notes.en: With OP Configurator, knobs also drive the OPC sliders in the order they are declared. A knob the sketch reads itself stays the sketch's: that slider no longer follows it.
notes.zh: 搭配 OP Configurator 時，旋鈕也會依宣告順序推動 OPC 的滑桿。草圖自己有讀的那顆旋鈕就歸草圖：對應的滑桿不再跟著動。

caption.en: Turn knob 1 and the whole canvas goes from black to white. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 轉旋鈕 1，整個畫布從黑變到白。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

caption.en: Two knobs, two jobs: size and colour.
caption.zh: 兩顆旋鈕，兩件事：大小與顏色。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it whenever a knob moves.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式；旋鈕一轉動，oav-p5 就呼叫它。

params.name: n
params.en: Which knob (1 is the first, as printed on the controller).
params.zh: 哪一顆旋鈕（1 是第一顆，照控制器上印的）。

params.name: value
params.en: Where it is now, 0..1.
params.zh: 現在的位置，0..1。

caption.en: Shows which knob moved and where it is. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 顯示哪一顆旋鈕動了、現在在哪。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

summary.en: The MIDI number (0 to 127) of the last key pressed.
summary.zh: 最後被按下的那個鍵的 MIDI 號碼（0 到 127）。

description.en: Middle C is 60, A4 is 69. [`noteName(note)`](#noteName) writes the number as a name (`60` → `'C4'`) and [`noteFreq(note)`](#noteFreq) as a frequency in Hz. [`velocity`](#velocity) says how hard it was pressed. For every key, not just the last, define [`notePressed()`](#notePressed).
description.zh: 中央 C 是 60，A4 是 69。[`noteName(note)`](#noteName) 把號碼寫成音名（`60` → `'C4'`），[`noteFreq(note)`](#noteFreq) 換成赫茲。[`velocity`](#velocity) 告訴你按得多用力。想要每個鍵都知道、不只最後一個，就定義 [`notePressed()`](#notePressed)。

value.en: Set when a key goes down and kept after it is released; 0 before any key has been pressed.
value.zh: 鍵按下的時候設定，放開之後也保留；還沒有按過任何鍵之前是 0。

needs.en: Unlike `knob1`, reading it does not by itself ask for Web MIDI: a sketch that defines `notePressed()` or reads a knob or pad does. 🎹 and a phone always work.
needs.zh: 跟 `knob1` 不一樣，單單讀它不會去要 Web MIDI：草圖有定義 `notePressed()`，或讀了旋鈕、墊子，才會去要。🎹 和手機隨時都能用。

notes.en: A sketch with its own `note` (a `let note`, a function) keeps it; read `midi.last.note` instead. oav-p5 says so in a card the first time.
notes.zh: 草圖如果自己有 `note`（`let note`、函式都算），就由草圖保留；改讀 `midi.last.note`。oav-p5 第一次會用卡片告訴你。

caption.en: Shows the name of the last key you played. Plug in a controller, or press 🎹 (bottom right) and use the on-screen one.
caption.zh: 顯示你最後彈的那個鍵的名字。接上控制器，或按右下角的 🎹 用螢幕上的控制器。

summary.en: True while the key `n` (a MIDI number or a name like `'C4'`) is held down.
summary.zh: 鍵 `n`（MIDI 號碼，或像 `'C4'` 這樣的音名）按著的時候是 true。

description.en: The MIDI version of `keyIsDown()`. `noteIsDown('C4')` is the same as `noteIsDown(60)`: C4 is middle C. A name that is not a note (`'H4'`, `'C-2'`) stops the sketch with a one-line card saying how to write it.
description.zh: 就是 MIDI 版的 `keyIsDown()`。`noteIsDown('C4')` 跟 `noteIsDown(60)` 一樣：C4 是中央 C。不是音符的名稱（`'H4'`、`'C-2'`）會讓草圖停下來，並用一張卡片告訴你怎麼寫。

params.name: n
params.en: The key: a MIDI number (60) or a note name (`'C4'`, `'c#4'`, `'Db3'`).

returns.en: True if that key is down right now.
returns.zh: 那個鍵現在按著就是 true。

caption.en: A circle that lights up only while C4 (middle C) is held. On the on-screen keyboard, middle C is the C labelled C4.
caption.zh: 只有按著 C4（中央 C）的時候才亮的圓。螢幕鍵盤上，標著 C4 的那個 C 就是中央 C。

summary.en: True while at least one key is held down.
summary.zh: 只要有任何一個鍵按著，就是 true。

description.en: To ask about one particular key, use [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown). `midi.held` lists every key held right now, lowest first.
description.zh: 想問某一個特定的鍵，用 [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown)。`midi.held` 列出現在按著的所有鍵，由低到高。

value.en: Like `keyIsPressed`, for MIDI keys. False when nothing is held.
value.zh: 像 `keyIsPressed`，但是對 MIDI 琴鍵。沒有任何鍵按著就是 false。

caption.en: The background lightens while any key is held.
caption.zh: 只要有鍵按著，背景就變亮。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it each time a key (or a pad) goes down.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式；每當有一個鍵（或打擊墊）按下，oav-p5 就呼叫它。

params.name: note
params.en: The MIDI number of the key (60 is middle C). [`noteName(note)`](#noteName) turns it into a name.
params.zh: 這個鍵的 MIDI 號碼（60 是中央 C）。[`noteName(note)`](#noteName) 可以把它轉成音名。

params.name: velocity
params.en: How hard, 0..1.

needs.en: Defining it is enough: oav-p5 sees the function and asks for Web MIDI. Keys from 🎹 and from a phone call it too.
needs.zh: 只要定義了它就夠了：oav-p5 看到這個函式，就會去要 Web MIDI。🎹 和手機上彈的鍵也會呼叫它。

notes.en: An error inside it does not stop the music: the next key still plays, and the message shows in the console and on a card beside the 🎹, with the file and line.
notes.zh: 裡面出錯不會讓音樂停掉：下一個鍵還是照樣處理，錯誤訊息會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案與行號。

caption.en: Every key leaves a circle: low keys on the left, high on the right, harder keys bigger.
caption.zh: 每個鍵留下一個圓：低音在左、高音在右，按得越用力圓越大。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it each time a key (or a pad) is let go.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式；每當有一個鍵（或打擊墊）放開，oav-p5 就呼叫它。

params.name: note
params.en: The MIDI number of the key that was released.
params.zh: 被放開的那個鍵的 MIDI 號碼。

caption.en: Lists the names of the keys that are down right now.
caption.zh: 列出現在按著的那些鍵的名字。

summary.en: Returns how hard pad number `n` is pressed, 0 to 1: the same as `pad1` to `pad16`, for any `n`.
summary.zh: 回傳第 `n` 個打擊墊被按得多用力，0 到 1：跟 `pad1` 到 `pad16` 一樣，但 `n` 可以是任何數字。

description.en: The function form of [`pad1`](#pad1).
description.zh: [`pad1`](#pad1) 的函式版本。

params.name: n
params.en: Which pad, counting from 1.
params.zh: 第幾個墊子，從 1 開始算。

returns.en: The velocity while the pad is held (0..1), 0 when it is released.
returns.zh: 墊子按著的時候是力道（0..1），放開是 0。

caption.en: A grid of eight squares that light up under the pads you hit.
caption.zh: 八個方塊排成格子，你打哪個墊子，哪個方塊就亮起來。

summary.en: How hard a drum pad is pressed, from 0 to 1: `pad1` is the first pad, up to `pad16`; 0 when it is let go.
summary.zh: 打擊墊被按得多用力，從 0 到 1：`pad1` 是第一個墊子，一直到 `pad16`；放開就是 0。

description.en: Read it like a held mouse button that also knows how hard: `if (pad1 > 0) fill(255, 90, 31)`. Pads are numbered in the order the controller's profile lists them. To react once per hit rather than ask every frame, define [`padPressed()`](#padPressed).
description.zh: 像一個知道力道的滑鼠按鍵那樣讀：`if (pad1 > 0) fill(255, 90, 31)`。墊子編號依控制器設定檔列出的順序。想「每打一下反應一次」而不是每個畫面都問，就定義 [`padPressed()`](#padPressed)。

value.en: The velocity of the hit while the pad is held (1 is as hard as the controller sends), and 0 as soon as it is released.
value.zh: 墊子按著的時候是這一下的力道（1 是控制器能送出的最大力道），一放開就變成 0。

needs.en: Nothing to call; reading a pad asks for Web MIDI, like a knob.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫任何東西；讀墊子就會像旋鈕一樣去要 Web MIDI。

caption.en: The circle swells while pad 1 is down, more for a harder hit. On the on-screen controller, click the first pad.
caption.zh: 按著墊子 1 的時候圓會脹大，打得越用力越大。用螢幕上的控制器就點第一個墊子。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it each time a drum pad is hit.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式；每打一下打擊墊，oav-p5 就呼叫它一次。

params.name: n
params.en: Which pad (1 is the first).
params.zh: 哪個墊子（1 是第一個）。

params.name: velocity
params.en: How hard, 0..1.

caption.en: Each hit pops a circle where its pad would sit on a 4×2 grid, and it fades away.
caption.zh: 每打一下，就在那個墊子在 4×2 格子裡的位置冒出一個圓，然後慢慢消失。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it each time a drum pad is let go.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式；每當打擊墊放開，oav-p5 就呼叫它。

description.en: The partner of [`padPressed()`](#padPressed): `function padReleased(n) { … }`. Without it, a pad calls [`noteReleased()`](#noteReleased).
description.zh: [`padPressed()`](#padPressed) 的另一半：`function padReleased(n) { … }`。沒有定義的話，打擊墊會呼叫 [`noteReleased()`](#noteReleased)。

params.name: n
params.en: Which pad (1 is the first).
params.zh: 哪個墊子（1 是第一個）。

caption.en: A square per pad, lit from press to release.
caption.zh: 一個墊子一個方塊，從按下到放開都亮著。

summary.en: How hard the last key was pressed, from 0 to 1.
summary.zh: 最後那個鍵被按得多用力，從 0 到 1。

description.en: MIDI sends velocity as 0 to 127; oav-p5 hands you it divided by 127, so 1 is the hardest hit the controller can send.
description.zh: MIDI 的力道是 0 到 127；oav-p5 給你的是除以 127 之後的值，所以 1 就是控制器能送出的最大力道。

value.en: Set together with [`note`](#note) when a key goes down; kept after release; 0 before any key.
value.zh: 跟 [`note`](#note) 一起在鍵按下的時候設定；放開之後保留；還沒按過任何鍵之前是 0。

notes.en: A sketch with its own `velocity` keeps it; read `midi.last.value`.
notes.zh: 草圖自己有 `velocity` 的話就由草圖保留；改讀 `midi.last.value`。

caption.en: The circle stays at the size of the last key's velocity.
caption.zh: 圓的大小停在最後那個鍵的力道上。

summary.en: Plays a key as if a controller did: `midi.play(60, 0.8)` presses middle C, `midi.play(60, 0)` lets it go.
summary.zh: 像控制器那樣彈一個鍵：`midi.play(60, 0.8)` 按下中央 C，`midi.play(60, 0)` 放開。

description.en: It sends the same MIDI bytes a keyboard would, with `midi.last.source` set to `'screen'`, so everything reacts: [`notePressed()`](#notePressed), [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown), [`note`](#note), the sound if [`startSound()`](#startSound) is on. `midi` and `OAVp5` are the same object, so `OAVp5.play` and `midi.play` are one function.
description.zh: 它送出的 MIDI 位元組跟鍵盤送出的一樣，`midi.last.source` 會是 `'screen'`，所以所有東西都會有反應：[`notePressed()`](#notePressed)、[`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown)、[`note`](#note)，還有開著 [`startSound()`](#startSound) 時的聲音。`midi` 和 `OAVp5` 是同一個物件，所以 `OAVp5.play` 和 `midi.play` 是同一個函式。

params.name: note
params.en: The key: a MIDI number or a name (`'C#4'`).
params.zh: 哪個鍵：MIDI 號碼或音名（`'C#4'`）。

params.name: velocity
params.en: How hard, 0..1; 0 releases the key. Leave it out for full force.
params.zh: 多用力，0..1；0 表示放開。不給就是最大力道。

notes.en: The key stays down until you play it again with velocity 0.
notes.zh: 鍵會一直按著，直到你再用力道 0 彈一次。

caption.en: The mouse plays middle C: the sketch hears it the same as a key.
caption.zh: 用滑鼠彈中央 C：草圖聽到的跟按鍵一模一樣。

summary.en: Returns the frequency in Hz of a note: `noteFreq('A4')` is 440.
summary.zh: 回傳音符的頻率（赫茲）：`noteFreq('A4')` 是 440。

description.en: For a sketch that makes its own sound (p5.sound, Web Audio): `osc.freq(noteFreq(note))`. If you just want the sound, [`startSound()`](#startSound) plays every key for you.
description.zh: 給自己發聲的草圖用（p5.sound、Web Audio）：`osc.freq(noteFreq(note))`。如果只是想要有聲音，[`startSound()`](#startSound) 會幫你把每個鍵都彈出來。

params.name: v
params.en: A note name or a MIDI number. A number may be fractional (69.5 is a quarter tone above A4) and is not held to 0..127.
params.zh: 音名或 MIDI 號碼。數字可以有小數（69.5 是比 A4 高四分之一音），而且不會被限制在 0..127。

returns.en: Hz, equal temperament with A4 = 69 = 440 Hz.

caption.en: Prints 440 Hz and 261.63 Hz.
caption.zh: 印出 440 Hz 和 261.63 Hz。

summary.en: Turns a MIDI number into a note name: `noteName(61)` is `'C#4'`.
summary.zh: 把 MIDI 號碼轉成音名：`noteName(61)` 是 `'C#4'`。

description.en: [`notePressed(note, velocity)`](#notePressed) hands you the number; `noteName(note)` writes it back as a name for the screen or a lookup table. The same C4-is-60 convention as [`noteNumber()`](#noteNumber).
description.zh: [`notePressed(note, velocity)`](#notePressed) 給你的是號碼；`noteName(note)` 把它寫回音名，拿去顯示在畫面上或查表。跟 [`noteNumber()`](#noteNumber) 一樣，C4 就是 60。

params.name: v
params.en: A MIDI number (or a name, which is normalised).
params.zh: MIDI 號碼（給音名的話會被整理成標準寫法）。

params.name: o
params.en: Options: `{ flats: true }` writes `'Db4'` instead of `'C#4'`; `{ octave: false }` drops the octave number (`'C#'`).
params.zh: 選項：`{ flats: true }` 寫成 `'Db4'` 而不是 `'C#4'`；`{ octave: false }` 不寫八度數字（`'C#'`）。

returns.en: The name, sharps by default: `noteName(60)` is `'C4'`.
returns.zh: 音名，預設用升記號：`noteName(60)` 是 `'C4'`。

caption.en: Shows each key twice, with sharps and with flats (they differ on black keys). Open 🎹 and play.
caption.zh: 每個鍵用升記號和降記號各寫一次（黑鍵兩種寫法不同）。打開 🎹 彈彈看。

summary.en: Turns a note name like `'C4'` into its MIDI number, 0 to 127.
summary.zh: 把像 `'C4'` 這樣的音名轉成 MIDI 號碼，0 到 127。

description.en: A name is a letter A to G (either case), an optional `#` or `b` (`♯` and `♭` too), and the octave: `C4`, `c#4`, `Db3`, `C-1` (0) up to `G9` (127). **C4 is 60.** Anything else, such as `'H4'` or `'C-2'`, throws an error, and a card beside the 🎹 says how to write a note.
description.zh: 音名由一個 A 到 G 的字母（大小寫都可以）、可有可無的 `#` 或 `b`（`♯`、`♭` 也行），加上八度數字組成：`C4`、`c#4`、`Db3`，從 `C-1`（0）到 `G9`（127）。**C4 是 60。** 其他寫法（像 `'H4'`、`'C-2'`）會丟出錯誤，🎹 旁邊也會有一張卡片告訴你音名怎麼寫。

description.en: You rarely call it yourself: every place that takes a note number also takes a name, such as [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown) and [`midi.play()`](#OAVp5.play).
description.zh: 通常不用自己呼叫：凡是收音符號碼的地方也都收音名，像 [`noteIsDown()`](#noteIsDown) 和 [`midi.play()`](#OAVp5.play)。

params.name: v
params.en: A note name (`'C4'`, `'c#4'`, `'Db3'`, `'F♯2'`) or a number. A number comes back rounded and held to 0..127.

returns.zh: MIDI 號碼：`noteNumber('C4')` 是 60，`noteNumber('A4')` 是 69。

caption.en: Prints 60, 69 and 42.

summary.en: How much of the microphone's sound is low (`bass`), middle (`mid`) or high (`treble`), each from 0 to 1.
summary.zh: 麥克風聽到的聲音裡，低音（`bass`）、中音（`mid`）、高音（`treble`）各佔多少，各自從 0 到 1。

description.en: Use them like [`micLevel`](#micLevel), one number per band: `fill(200 + bass * 160, 70, 100)` pushes the colour with the low end. The three share one entry because they behave the same; only the frequency range differs.
description.zh: 用法跟 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 一樣，每個頻段一個數字：`fill(200 + bass * 160, 70, 100)` 讓顏色跟著低音走。三個名稱共用這一條，因為它們的行為完全相同，只有頻率範圍不同。

description.en: Unlike `micLevel` they are not measured in decibels: each is the average strength of the frequencies in its band, scaled by [`micSensitivity()`](#micSensitivity) and held to 1. A band that is faint in your room can stay close to 0; raise the sensitivity rather than multiplying by a large number.
description.zh: 跟 `micLevel` 不一樣，它們不是用分貝量的：每一個是該頻段所有頻率的平均強度，乘上 [`micSensitivity()`](#micSensitivity) 之後最多算到 1。如果某個頻段在你的房間裡很微弱，數字會一直貼近 0；這時調高靈敏度，比自己乘一個很大的數字好。

value.en: The energy in 20–250 Hz (`bass`), 250–2000 Hz (`mid`) and 2000–8000 Hz (`treble`). Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on; 0 otherwise.
value.zh: `bass` 是 20–250 Hz 的能量，`mid` 是 250–2000 Hz，`treble` 是 2000–8000 Hz。麥克風開著時每個畫面更新一次，其他時候是 0。

needs.en: Reading any of them asks for the microphone the first time, exactly like [`micLevel`](#micLevel); until you allow it they are `0`.
needs.zh: 第一次讀其中任何一個，就會跟 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 一樣去要麥克風；在你允許之前都是 `0`。

notes.en: A sketch that already has its own variable, function or library called `bass`, `mid` or `treble` keeps it: oav-p5 leaves that name alone and never starts the microphone for it. Assigning one later turns the name back into a plain variable.
notes.zh: 如果草圖本來就有自己的 `bass`、`mid` 或 `treble`（變數、函式、函式庫都算），oav-p5 就不動那個名稱，也不會為它去開麥克風。之後自己指定值的話，那個名稱就變回一般變數。

caption.en: A circle that swells and changes colour with the low end: tap the desk or play something with a kick.
caption.zh: 一個隨低音變大、變色的圓：敲桌子或放一段有大鼓的音樂。

caption.en: Three bars, one per band, from low to high. Whistle for the right one, hum for the left.
caption.zh: 三根長條，依序是低、中、高音。吹口哨看右邊那根，哼低音看左邊那根。

tbd.en: Typical values for speech and for music depend on the microphone and the room; no typical numbers are given here until they have been measured.
tbd.zh: 說話和音樂的典型數值要看麥克風和房間；在量過之前，這裡不給典型數字。

summary.en: True for one frame each time the microphone (or the drum machine) hears a beat.
summary.zh: 麥克風（或鼓機）每聽到一個拍子，就在那一個畫面是 true。

description.en: It behaves like `mouseIsPressed` while a button is down, except the "press" lasts one frame: `if (beat) flash = 1;` is all it takes to react to the music. A beat is a jump in loudness over what the room has been doing, with at least 100 ms between two beats; two beats between two frames count as one.
description.zh: 它的用法像按著滑鼠鍵時的 `mouseIsPressed`，只是「按下」只持續一個畫面：`if (beat) flash = 1;` 就能對音樂做出反應。一個拍子是音量比房間一直以來的聲音突然跳高，兩個拍子之間至少隔 100 毫秒；兩個畫面之間發生的兩個拍子只算一次。

description.en: When the drum machine is playing, `beat` is also true for a frame on every kick and snare, so a sketch written for the microphone moves over to the machine unchanged.
description.zh: 鼓機在播的時候，每一下大鼓和小鼓也會讓 `beat` 在那個畫面是 true，所以為麥克風寫的草圖不用改就能換成鼓機。

value.en: True in the first `draw()` after a beat, and false until the next one. Reading it twice in the same frame gives the same answer.
value.zh: 拍子之後的第一個 `draw()` 是 true，到下一個拍子之前都是 false。同一個畫面裡讀兩次，答案一樣。

needs.en: Reading `beat` asks for the microphone the first time, like [`micLevel`](#micLevel). If you would rather be called, define [`beatDetected()`](#beatDetected).
needs.zh: 第一次讀 `beat` 就會跟 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 一樣去要麥克風。如果你比較想被呼叫，就定義 [`beatDetected()`](#beatDetected)。

caption.en: The screen flashes on every beat and fades out. Clap or tap the desk.
caption.zh: 每個拍子畫面閃一下再慢慢暗下去。拍手或敲桌子試試。

caption.en: A counter that goes up by one per beat, never twice for the same one.
caption.zh: 每個拍子加一的計數器，同一個拍子不會算兩次。

summary.en: You define this function; oav-p5 calls it each time the microphone (or the drum machine) hears a beat.
summary.zh: 你來定義這個函式；麥克風（或鼓機）每聽到一個拍子，oav-p5 就呼叫它一次。

params.name: level
params.en: How loud it was at that moment, 0..1 (the value of [`micLevel`](#micLevel)).
params.zh: 那一刻有多大聲，0..1（就是 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 的值）。

needs.en: A sketch that defines `beatDetected()` and reads no microphone value starts the microphone on the first click or key. When the drum machine is on, the same function is called for its kicks and snares and the microphone is not opened for it. `OAVp5.mic.on('beat', fn)` is the same thing without defining a global; it returns a function that stops listening.
needs.zh: 草圖只要定義了 `beatDetected()` 而沒有讀任何麥克風的值，第一次點擊或按鍵時就會啟動麥克風。鼓機開著的時候，鼓機的大鼓和小鼓也會呼叫同一個函式，而且不會為它去開麥克風。`OAVp5.mic.on('beat', fn)` 是不必定義全域函式的同樣功能，它會回傳一個停止監聽的函式。

notes.en: If your function throws, the sketch keeps running: the error appears in the console and as a card beside the 🎹 with the file and line.
notes.zh: 你的函式如果出錯，草圖會繼續跑：錯誤會出現在 console，也會在 🎹 旁邊的卡片上顯示檔案和行號。

caption.en: A flash per beat, brighter for a louder one.
caption.zh: 每個拍子閃一下，拍子越大聲閃得越亮。

summary.en: You define these; oav-p5 calls them when the microphone (or the drum machine) hears a kick, a snare or a hat.
summary.zh: 你來定義這幾個函式；麥克風（或鼓機）聽到大鼓、小鼓或鈸的時候，oav-p5 會呼叫 `kickDetected(level)`、`snareDetected(level)`、`hatDetected(level)`。

description.en: The microphone splits what it hears into three drum-like bands and calls the matching function when each band jumps: 20–120 Hz for the kick, 150–800 Hz for the snare, 6–14 kHz for the hat. There is no machine learning in it, just a transient in a frequency band, so a bass voice can trigger a kick.
description.zh: 麥克風把聽到的聲音分成三個像鼓的頻段，哪個頻段突然跳高，就呼叫對應的函式：大鼓是 20–120 Hz，小鼓是 150–800 Hz，鈸是 6–14 kHz。裡面沒有機器學習，只是某個頻段出現瞬間的衝擊，所以低沉的人聲也可能觸發大鼓。

description.en: When the drum machine plays, each of its hits calls the same functions: kick for the kick, snare for a snare, clap or rim, hat for a closed, open or pedal hat. A sketch written for the microphone therefore works with [`startDrums()`](#startDrums) unchanged.
description.zh: 鼓機在播的時候，它的每一下也會呼叫同樣的函式：大鼓呼叫 kick，小鼓、拍手或 rim 呼叫 snare，閉合、開放或腳踏的鈸呼叫 hat。所以為麥克風寫的草圖，不用改就能搭配 [`startDrums()`](#startDrums)。

params.name: level
params.en: How strong the hit was, 0..1 (for the drum machine, its velocity).
params.zh: 這一下有多強，0..1（鼓機的話就是力道）。

needs.en: Defining one of them is not enough to open the microphone once the drum machine has started; reading [`micLevel`](#micLevel) (or calling [`startMic()`](#startMic)) is. Without the drum machine, a sketch that defines any of them and reads nothing starts the microphone on the first click or key.
needs.zh: 鼓機啟動之後，只定義其中一個函式並不會去開麥克風；要讀 [`micLevel`](#micLevel)（或呼叫 [`startMic()`](#startMic)）才會。沒有鼓機的時候，草圖只要定義了其中任何一個、又沒有讀任何值，第一次點擊或按鍵時會啟動麥克風。

caption.en: Two circles, orange for kicks and blue for snares, each swelling and shrinking back on its own hits.
caption.zh: 兩個圓，橘色對應大鼓、藍色對應小鼓，各自在自己的聲音出現時脹大再縮回去。

summary.en: Whether the microphone is running right now.
summary.zh: 麥克風現在有沒有在運作。

description.en: Use it to show a hint until sound arrives: `if (!micIsOn) text("Allow the microphone", 20, 30);`. Reading it never starts the microphone (unlike [`micLevel`](#micLevel)), so it is safe to check anywhere. The reason behind a `false` is in `OAVp5.mic.state` (`off`, `asking`, `on`, `denied` or `unavailable`) and, when something failed, `OAVp5.mic.error`.
description.zh: 可以用它在聲音進來之前顯示提示：`if (!micIsOn) text("請允許麥克風", 20, 30);`。讀它不會啟動麥克風（跟 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 不一樣），所以在哪裡檢查都安全。`false` 的原因看 `OAVp5.mic.state`（`off`、`asking`、`on`、`denied` 或 `unavailable`），失敗的時候還有 `OAVp5.mic.error`。

value.en: True once the browser has said yes and sound is coming in; false while the microphone is off, still asking, blocked or missing.
value.zh: 瀏覽器答應了、聲音進來之後是 true；麥克風關著、還在詢問、被擋下或不存在的時候是 false。

caption.en: Grey with a prompt until the microphone is on, then dark. (Nothing here reads micLevel, so nothing asks for the microphone: press 🎤 in the 🎹 panel.)
caption.zh: 麥克風開起來之前是灰色加提示，開了之後變暗。（這裡沒有讀 micLevel，所以不會自己去要麥克風：按 🎹 面板裡的 🎤。）

summary.en: How loud the microphone hears things, from 0 (a quiet room) to 1 (shouting).
summary.zh: 麥克風聽到的聲音有多大聲，從 0（安靜的房間）到 1（大喊）。

description.en: Read it in `draw()` the way you read `mouseX`: `circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + micLevel * 300)` grows when someone talks. It is a loudness in decibels, which is how an ear hears it, measured from the room itself: the bottom of the scale follows the room's own noise (it settles within a second or two and rises at most 1.5 dB a second, so a voice never becomes the new silence), and −10 dBFS, shouting into a laptop, is 1.
description.zh: 像讀 `mouseX` 一樣在 `draw()` 裡直接讀：`circle(width / 2, height / 2, 50 + micLevel * 300)`，有人說話圓就變大。它是以分貝量的音量，跟耳朵聽起來的感覺一致，而且是從房間本身量起：量表的底部跟著房間的底噪走（一兩秒內安頓下來，每秒最多往上爬 1.5 dB，所以人聲不會變成新的安靜），−10 dBFS（對著筆電大喊）就是 1。

description.en: In practice a quiet room reads 0, a quiet voice about 0.4 to 0.6, shouting close to 1. If the microphone is quiet or far away, raise it with [`micSensitivity()`](#micSensitivity).
description.zh: 實際上，安靜的房間是 0，小聲說話約 0.4 到 0.6，大喊接近 1。麥克風很小聲或離得很遠的話，用 [`micSensitivity()`](#micSensitivity) 把它調大。

description.en: It follows the browser's animation frames rather than `draw()`, so a sketch running at `frameRate(10)` still reads the latest value, and the number stops changing while the tab is hidden (browsers pause animation frames there).
description.zh: 它跟著瀏覽器的動畫畫面更新，不是跟著 `draw()`，所以用 `frameRate(10)` 跑的草圖讀到的還是最新的值；分頁被藏起來時數字會停住（瀏覽器在那時會暫停動畫畫面）。

value.en: Updated once per display frame while the microphone is on. It is 0 while the microphone is off, still asking, blocked or missing.
value.zh: 麥克風開著的時候，每個畫面更新一次。麥克風關著、還在詢問、被擋下或根本沒有的時候，一直是 0。

needs.en: Nothing to call. The first time a sketch reads `micLevel` (or [`bass`](#bass), `mid`, `treble`, [`beat`](#beat)), oav-p5 asks the browser for the microphone, and every value stays `0` until you allow it. The page needs `https` or `localhost`. If the browser kept audio quiet until a click, the first click or key starts it. [`?oav_mic=click`](#option-mic) makes only the 🎤 button and [`startMic()`](#startMic) turn it on; `?oav_mic=off` means nothing can.
needs.zh: 不用呼叫任何東西。草圖第一次讀 `micLevel`（或 [`bass`](#bass)、`mid`、`treble`、[`beat`](#beat)）的時候，oav-p5 就會向瀏覽器要麥克風，在你按下允許之前所有的值都是 `0`。網頁要在 `https` 或 `localhost` 底下。如果瀏覽器在你點一下之前不讓聲音出來，第一次點擊或按鍵就會把它啟動。[`?oav_mic=click`](#option-mic) 表示只有 🎤 按鈕和 [`startMic()`](#startMic) 能開；`?oav_mic=off` 表示什麼都開不了。

notes.en: In the 🎹 panel the 🎤 button turns the microphone on and off by hand and shows the level. When the browser blocked it, a card beside the 🎹 says why and what to press: click the lock left of the address, set Microphone to Allow, then click the canvas.
notes.zh: 🎹 面板裡的 🎤 按鈕可以手動開關麥克風，並顯示音量。瀏覽器擋下麥克風的時候，🎹 旁邊會跳出一張卡片說明原因和怎麼處理：點網址列左邊的鎖頭，把麥克風設成允許，再點一下畫布。

notes.en: On OpenProcessing's own page the sketch frame is meant to allow the microphone. An embed code copied from OpenProcessing does not: add `allow="microphone"` to that `<iframe>`.
notes.zh: OpenProcessing 自己的頁面上，草圖的框是設計成允許麥克風的。從 OpenProcessing 複製出來的嵌入碼就不允許：要在那個 `<iframe>` 加上 `allow="microphone"`。

notes.en: The raw numbers behind it are [`OAVp5.mic.rms`](#OAVp5.mic.rms) (0..1), `OAVp5.mic.db` and `OAVp5.mic.floor` (the room's own noise, in dBFS).
notes.zh: 它背後的原始數字是 [`OAVp5.mic.rms`](#OAVp5.mic.rms)（0..1）、`OAVp5.mic.db` 和 `OAVp5.mic.floor`（房間本身的底噪，單位 dBFS）。

caption.en: Allow the microphone when the browser asks, then talk: the circle grows with your voice.
caption.zh: 瀏覽器詢問的時候按允許，然後說話：圓會跟著你的聲音變大。

caption.en: The same circle through lag(): it opens at once when someone speaks and closes slowly, like a VU meter.
caption.zh: 同一個圓，加上 lag()：有人開口就立刻張開，之後慢慢收回去，像音量表。

caption.en: A bar that fills with the level. micIsOn tells you whether the browser has said yes yet.
caption.zh: 一條隨音量變長的橫條。micIsOn 告訴你瀏覽器是不是已經答應了。

tbd.en: Not yet tried on openprocessing.org itself: whether its sketch frame lets the microphone prompt appear.
tbd.zh: 還沒有在 openprocessing.org 本站實測：它的草圖框是否會讓麥克風的詢問跳出來。

summary.en: Makes the microphone more or less sensitive: `micSensitivity(2)` is twice as sensitive, `micSensitivity()` says what it is now.
summary.zh: 調整麥克風的靈敏度：`micSensitivity(2)` 是兩倍靈敏，`micSensitivity()` 會告訴你現在是多少。

description.en: The number multiplies what the microphone hears. On [`micLevel`](#micLevel), 2 adds 6 dB; on [`bass`](#bass), `mid` and `treble` it multiplies by 2 (they stay held to 1). Use it for a quiet microphone or a far-away voice: `micSensitivity(3)` in `setup()` adds about 9.5 dB.
description.zh: 這個數字乘在麥克風聽到的東西上。對 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 來說，2 等於加 6 dB；對 [`bass`](#bass)、`mid`、`treble` 是乘以 2（最多還是 1）。麥克風很小聲或人離得很遠的時候用它：在 `setup()` 寫 `micSensitivity(3)` 大約加 9.5 dB。

params.name: v
params.en: The new sensitivity, greater than 0 (kept between 0.05 and 20). Leave it out, or pass something that is not greater than 0, to change nothing.
params.zh: 新的靈敏度，要大於 0（會被限制在 0.05 到 20 之間）。不傳，或傳不大於 0 的值，就什麼都不改。

returns.en: The sensitivity now in effect (1 until you change it).
returns.zh: 現在生效的靈敏度（沒改過就是 1）。

notes.en: `OAVp5.mic.gain` is the same knob under the name oav-p5 0.3.0 used.
notes.zh: `OAVp5.mic.gain` 是同一個旋鈕，用的是 oav-p5 0.3.0 的舊名字。

caption.en: The same loudness circle on a microphone that needed a boost; the number shows the sensitivity in effect.
caption.zh: 同樣的音量圓，用在需要加強的麥克風上；數字顯示現在的靈敏度。

summary.en: Turns the microphone on and returns a promise that says whether it worked.
summary.zh: 開啟麥克風，並回傳一個 promise，告訴你有沒有成功。

description.en: You rarely need it: reading [`micLevel`](#micLevel) and its friends already starts the microphone. Call it when you want to choose the moment (a button, the end of an intro) or know the answer: `startMic().then((ok) => { … })`. Calling it again while it is on, or while the browser is still asking, returns the same result.
description.zh: 通常用不到：只要讀 [`micLevel`](#micLevel) 之類的名稱，麥克風就會自己啟動。想自己決定時機（一個按鈕、片頭結束的時候）或想知道結果時才呼叫：`startMic().then((ok) => { … })`。已經開著、或瀏覽器還在詢問的時候再呼叫，會回傳同一個結果。

returns.en: Resolves to `true` once the microphone is on, `false` if it was blocked, is missing, or the `mic` option is `off`.
returns.zh: 麥克風開起來之後 resolve 成 `true`；被擋下、不存在、或載入選項 `mic` 是 `off` 的時候 resolve 成 `false`。

needs.en: Browsers want a click before audio plays: call it from `mousePressed()` or a button handler if `setup()` is too early. It works whatever the `mic` option is, except `?oav_mic=off`, where nothing can start the microphone.
needs.zh: 瀏覽器要先有一次點擊才讓聲音出來：如果在 `setup()` 裡太早，就放在 `mousePressed()` 或按鈕的處理函式裡呼叫。不管載入選項 `mic` 是什麼都能用，只有 `?oav_mic=off` 例外，那時什麼都開不了麥克風。

notes.en: After [`stopMic()`](#stopMic), only `startMic()` (or 🎤) turns it back on; reading `micLevel` does not.
notes.zh: 呼叫過 [`stopMic()`](#stopMic) 之後，只有 `startMic()`（或 🎤）能再把它打開；讀 `micLevel` 不會。

caption.en: Nothing happens until you click; then the browser asks, and the number starts moving.
caption.zh: 點下去之前什麼都不會發生；點了之後瀏覽器才詢問，數字就開始動。

summary.en: Turns the microphone off and sets every microphone value back to 0.
summary.zh: 關掉麥克風，所有麥克風的值都歸零。

description.en: It stops the microphone's tracks and closes its audio context, so the browser's "recording" indicator goes away. [`micLevel`](#micLevel), [`bass`](#bass), `mid`, `treble` and the rest read `0` again, and [`micIsOn`](#micIsOn) is `false`.
description.zh: 它會停掉麥克風的音軌並關掉它的音訊環境，所以瀏覽器上「正在錄音」的指示會消失。[`micLevel`](#micLevel)、[`bass`](#bass)、`mid`、`treble` 等等都回到 `0`，[`micIsOn`](#micIsOn) 變成 `false`。

returns.en: Resolves to `false`, the new state of the microphone.
returns.zh: resolve 成 `false`，也就是麥克風的新狀態。

notes.en: After `stopMic()`, reading `micLevel` does not turn the microphone back on: that needs [`startMic()`](#startMic) or the 🎤 button.
notes.zh: `stopMic()` 之後，讀 `micLevel` 不會再把麥克風打開：要用 [`startMic()`](#startMic) 或 🎤 按鈕。

caption.en: Press m to switch the microphone on and off; the circle drops to its smallest size when it is off.
caption.zh: 按 m 開關麥克風；關掉的時候圓縮到最小。
